bay.alt: Two hikers on a dirt trail through coastal scrub near Battery Boyd, with the Golden Gate Bridge's red tower rising over the bay under a cloudy sky.

alcatraz.alt: A lone person in a dark jacket walks across the empty concrete recreation yard of Alcatraz, surrounded by tall walls, with the hazy bay and hills beyond.

ducks.alt: A early-morning mountain landscape in Rocky Mountain National Park with a lake in the foreground. Ducks are swimming in the lake.

golden.alt: A early-morning mountain landscape in Rocky Mountain National Park with a lake in the foreground.

birds.alt: Hundreds of dark cormorants crowd a guano-covered ledge and ruined wall on Alcatraz, with turquoise bay water behind them.

collapsed.alt: A collapsed barn of rusted corrugated metal and splintered timber, piled with cinder blocks and an old satellite dish, under fresh spring leaves.

droplets.alt: Close-up of round water droplets beaded along a blade of green grass, against a soft, dark green background.

baybeach.alt: Waves wash onto a sandy beach below eroded cliffs, with a few people walking toward the Golden Gate Bridge in the distance.

hamptonbeach.alt: Wide shot of an empty beach with two people walking

java.alt: Portrait of an orange tabby kitten with big ears and blue-green eyes, looking straight at the camera.

junk.alt: An overgrown backyard with a raised garden bed, red flowering shrubs, an old radiator panel and a scrap-metal sculpture beside a wooden deck.

bostonbuilding.alt: Architecture shot of a building at sunset

lights.alt: Black-and-white night shot of a dark building facade along an empty street, with a single light picking out the pipes of a standpipe valve.

mountain.alt: A partly thawed pond in the snow, ringed by pine forest, beneath a snow-capped rocky peak and blue sky.

pizza.alt: A red Pasquale's Pizzeria Restaurant sign on a street corner, with a striped awning, tangled power lines and Victorian houses behind.

plant.alt: Top-down view of a fuzzy, silvery-green leaf spotted with tiny water droplets, with blades of grass poking through.

rockymountain.alt: A calm mountain lake reflecting the sky, with a hiker on the rocky shore and snow-capped peaks rising beyond a pine forest.
